provenance.route: MAIN_LR (only populated software-reference route; not a hardware-fit declaration of canonical output behaviour)

mpc_rate_hz.note: 33.8688 MHz crystal = 768 x 44.1 kHz; the scheduling of this rate on the software proxy grid is IMPLEMENTATION.

converter_bits.note: AK5328 18-bit ADC and PCM69A 18-bit DAC: architecture only; installed performance NOT EXECUTED.

value.representation: signed 18-bit; clamp at limits (converter full-scale clamp required by architecture)

converter_code_range.note: Delta-sigma modulator overload and recovery UNKNOWN; only a code clamp is represented, no recovery dynamics (AUD-C05).

adc_code_representation.note: Code-domain representation only: the sampled value is rounded to the nearest 18-bit code (ties toward +inf). The modulator's noise shaping is not represented; no claim about the part.

reduction_rule_default.note: OWNER-SET PROVISIONAL SOFTWARE DEFAULT; the historical 18->16 rule is UNRESOLVED. Research alternate TRUNCATION (floor of the two LSBs of the two's-complement word) is selectable. Tie convention as OWN-DEC-003: ties toward +inf.

r14_arithmetic.note: Stored 16-bit code replayed unchanged at unity; re-expanded to the 18-bit DAC word by exact x4 (two zero LSBs). Mixer scaling/rounding UNKNOWN and not represented.

input_gain_steps.replaced_by: CHAIN-EXP-009 (measured switch gains and FS volts)
input_gain_steps.note: Printed sensitivities (0 dBs = 0.775 Vrms) define 20 dB steps; the absolute gain to converter full scale is UNKNOWN, so LO is a normalized reference (1.0). Sensitivity is not full scale.

record_level_law.note: Dual 10 kOhm audio-taper pot represented as an ideal dB trim (<= 0 dB, 0 dB = maximum); taper/position mapping UNKNOWN.

r12_strategy.note: TRANSPARENT = ideal band limitation at the machine Nyquist (22.05 kHz) + ideal sampling at 44.1 kHz + 18-bit code clamp. No AK5328 kernel, no invented decimation response, no overload recovery. The implementation kernel's transition band is an ESTIMATE recorded in PreparedInfo, not the part's. Reserved slots (not populated): ESTIMATE_FIR, DATASHEET_RESPONSE, MEASURED_RESPONSE.

r15_strategy.note: TRANSPARENT = unity x4 re-expansion of the stored code to the 18-bit DAC word + ideal band-limited reconstruction (flat to 22.05 kHz) onto the proxy grid; no 8x interpolation-filter response, no I/V, no analog low-pass, no coupling, no de-emphasis. The 8x oversampling domain is architecture only and is not instantiated. Reserved slots (not populated): ESTIMATE_FIR, DATASHEET_RESPONSE, MEASURED_RESPONSE.
